stories.title: Pakistan, Qatar sign MoU on security cooperation
stories.brief: Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi and Qatari counterpart, Sheikh Khalifa bin Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani, who is currently visiting Pakistan, signed the documents. The statement said that the Qatari minister thanked Pakistan for its hospitality.

stories.title: Navy’s combat capabilities significantly enhanced across all operational domains: Admiral Ashraf
stories.brief: Chief of the Naval Staff (CNS) Admiral Naveed Ashraf on Thursday said the Pakistan Navy has significantly enhanced its combat capabilities across all operational domains. The naval chief further said that the navy’s combat capabilities “have recently undergone significant enhancement and transformation across all operational domains aligned with contemporary and future warfare demands”.

stories.title: CDF Munir briefed on ongoing operations during Balochistan visit: ISPR
stories.brief: Chief of Defence Forces (CDF) and Chief of the Army Staff Field Marshal Asim Munir was briefed on counterterrorism operations during a visit to Turbat, Balochistan, the Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) said in a press release on Thursday.

stories.title: Pakistan, Qatar sign security cooperation agreement, action plan to curb drug trafficking
stories.brief: Pakistan and Qatar on Thursday signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) on security cooperation between Qatar's Internal Security Force (Lekhwiya) and Pakistan's Federal Constabulary, along with an action plan to prevent drug trafficking, the Prime Minister's Office (PMO) said.

stories.title: Pakistan Navy enhances combat capabilities to meet demands of future warfare: Naval chief
stories.brief: Naval Chief Admiral Naveed Ashraf on Thursday said the Pakistan Navy's combat capabilities had undergone significant enhancement and transformation across all operational domains to meet the demands of contemporary and future warfare.

stories.title: CDF Munir visits Turbat, reviews security situation and ongoing operations against terrorism
stories.brief: According to the Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR), he was given a comprehensive briefing on the prevailing security environment, operational preparedness, and successful ongoing operations against externally sponsored terrorism. He returned to Turbat in August 2025, where he reviewed the security situation, counterterrorism operations and ongoing development projects in southern Balochistan.

stories.title: Elon Musk says record $446m spending on US midterms was 'pretty foolish'
stories.brief: The multi-billionaire also said he was "not Maga", distancing himself from the political movement linked to Trump.

stories.title: The seven Anthropic founders who are about to become multi-billionaires
stories.brief: The AI company behind Claude is about to sell its shares on the US stock market - making its founders very rich.

stories.title: Airspace ban on Indian aircraft extended till Dec 23
stories.brief: Pakistan has extended its airspace ban on Indian aircraft until Dec 23, according to a Notice to Airmen (Notam) issued by the Pakistan Airports Authority (PAA).

stories.title: Parts of Bangladesh shut down in protests by Hasina's party, Yunus' home set ablaze
stories.brief: Parts of Bangladesh shut down as police said two ruling party members were killed and the ancestral home of former leader Muhammad Yunus was set ablaze in violence ahead of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina's return planned for December.

stories.title: Home of Bangladesh’s former leader Muhammad Yunus set on fire
stories.brief: The blaze broke out during heightened violence before ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina's planned return.

stories.title: Anthropic raises $81bn in record-breaking stock market debut
stories.brief: The company behind the Claude chatbot will become one of the most valuable firms in the world.

stories.title: Survivors of Uganda's deadly landslide seek justice at the UN
stories.brief: Survivors reject relocation plans they say ignore their safety, land rights and livelihoods

stories.title: Kenya’s marathon champion Peres Jepchirchir gets three-year ban for doping
stories.brief: Jepchirchir breached anti-doping rules by testing positive for banned substance EPO, Athletics Integrity Unit says.

stories.title: Violent protests and killings in Bangladesh ahead of exiled Sheikh Hasina’s planned return
stories.brief: Awami League party called for ⁠nationwide protest on Thursday after the government rejected Hasina’s request for passportParts of Bangladesh were shut down Thursday as protests by supporters of former prime minister Sheikh Hasina sparked clashes, bomb blasts and arson attacks, with the ancestral home ⁠of former leader Muhammad Yunus set ablaze in the violence.Hasina’s Awami…

stories.title: Simon Jack: Can Anthropic's record-breaking IPO stop the AI bubble bursting?
stories.brief: Anthropic's hotly anticipated IPO is expected to put it in the top 10 most valuable US companies, but the future is uncertain.

stories.title: Waymo pulls driverless taxis from all US freeways
stories.brief: The decision comes after California banned Waymo's driverless vehicles from operating on the state's highways following a series of traffic incidents.

stories.title: Nvidia says it won't reinstate Huang as it reports soaring sales
stories.brief: The AI chip giant reported strong quarterly earnings on Tuesday after the dramatic exit of Jensen Huang.

stories.title: China and Russia release 'peace declaration' after Trump, Xi, Putin meeting
stories.brief: Chinese President Xi Jinping and his US and Russian counterparts Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin agreed on a “peace declaration” at their unprecedented three-way meeting on Thursday in which they reaffirmed that a nuclear war should never be fought, China and Russia said.

stories.title: World marathon champion Jepchirchir gets three-year doping ban
stories.brief: Reigning world marathon champion Peres Jepchirchir is banned for three years for a doping violation.
